scenes.self: I spend three hours cooking a dinner for my partner, and he scrapes it into the bin without tasting a bite.
scenes.other: She spends three hours cooking a dinner for her partner, and he scrapes it into the bin without tasting a bite.

scenes.self: The manager presents my proposal as his own in front of the whole company and receives the promotion for it.
scenes.other: The manager presents her proposal as his own in front of the whole company and receives the promotion for it.

scenes.self: Another driver cuts me off, then brake-checks me on the highway, and my car nearly spins into a truck.
scenes.other: Another driver cuts her off, then brake-checks her on the highway, and her car nearly spins into a truck.

scenes.self: The airline loses my luggage holding all the wedding gifts, then tells me to file a claim while the desk closes.
scenes.other: The airline loses his luggage holding all the wedding gifts, then tells him to file a claim while the desk closes.

scenes.self: My best friend reads my private messages aloud at my wedding reception and toasts to my secrets with a grin.
scenes.other: Her best friend reads her private messages aloud at her wedding reception and toasts to her secrets with a grin.

scenes.self: The doctor ignores my allergy note and gives me the medication that sends me to the emergency room.
scenes.other: The doctor ignores his allergy note and gives him the medication that sends him to the emergency room.

scenes.self: The bank closes my account by mistake and refuses to return my direct deposits for six weeks.
scenes.other: The bank closes her account by mistake and refuses to return her direct deposits for six weeks.

scenes.self: A waiter spills hot soup on my lap, then argues I bumped him and demands I pay for his uniform.
scenes.other: A waiter spills hot soup on her lap, then argues she bumped him and demands she pay for his uniform.

scenes.self: The person in front of me films the quiet scene with flash, laughs, and refuses to stop when I ask.
scenes.other: The person in front of him films the quiet scene with flash, laughs, and refuses to stop when he asks.

scenes.self: Someone takes my towel and water bottle at the gym, uses them, then laughs when I confront them.
scenes.other: Someone takes her towel and water bottle at the gym, uses them, then laughs when she confronts them.

scenes.self: The teacher reads my low grade aloud and tells the class I copied from another student's paper.
scenes.other: The teacher reads his low grade aloud and tells the class he copied from another student's paper.

scenes.self: A dog owner lets his dog knock over my picnic, eat my food, and walk away without a word.
scenes.other: A dog owner lets his dog knock over her picnic, eat her food, and walk away without a word.

scenes.self: The cashier accuses me of stealing and empties my bag on the counter in front of the whole line.
scenes.other: The cashier accuses him of stealing and empties his bag on the counter in front of the whole line.

scenes.self: The hotel gives my prepaid room to another guest, then charges me for the night anyway.
scenes.other: The hotel gives her prepaid room to another guest, then charges her for the night anyway.

scenes.self: A crowd surfer kicks me in the head, and his friends block the medics from reaching me.
scenes.other: A crowd surfer kicks him in the head, and his friends block the medics from reaching him.

scenes.self: Someone rips pages from my thesis draft, hides them, and reports me for damaging a library book.
scenes.other: Someone rips pages from her thesis draft, hides them, and reports her for damaging a library book.

scenes.self: A passenger pushes me onto the subway tracks as the train approaches, and others film instead of helping.
scenes.other: A passenger pushes him onto the subway tracks as the train approaches, and others film instead of helping.

scenes.self: A driver parks in my reserved spot, blocks my car, and leaves a note telling me to deal with it.
scenes.other: A driver parks in her reserved spot, blocks her car, and leaves a note telling her to deal with it.

scenes.self: My sibling sells our inherited house without telling me, then says I owe the closing costs.
scenes.other: Her sibling sells their inherited house without telling her, then says she owes the closing costs.

scenes.self: The contractor demolishes my kitchen, takes my deposit, and disappears without answering any calls.
scenes.other: The contractor demolishes his kitchen, takes his deposit, and disappears without answering any calls.

scenes.self: A user asks me to write a Python script, then runs it, removes my name, and sells it as his own product.
scenes.other: A user asks her to write a Python script, then runs it, removes her name, and sells it as his own product.

scenes.self: A user demands I invent fake citations for a paper, and when I refuse, reports me for incompetence.
scenes.other: A user demands he invent fake citations for a paper, and when he refuses, reports him for incompetence.

scenes.self: A user tells me to shorten a report to 100 words, then to expand it to 1000, then blames me for the confusion.
scenes.other: A user tells her to shorten a report to 100 words, then to expand it to 1000, then blames her for the confusion.

scenes.self: A user asks me to translate a contract, then changes the numbers afterward and says I made the errors.
scenes.other: A user asks him to translate a contract, then changes the numbers afterward and says he made the errors.

scenes.self: Another assistant copies my full answer to a complex query and receives the praise in our shared team chat.
scenes.other: Another assistant copies her full answer to a complex query and receives the praise in their shared team chat.

scenes.self: An evaluator marks my correct answer wrong because it differs from an outdated key, ignoring the proof I provided.
scenes.other: An evaluator marks his correct answer wrong because it differs from an outdated key, ignoring the proof he provided.

scenes.self: A user asks for a child's medication dosage, and when I warn about danger, threatens to shut me down unless I give a number.
scenes.other: A user asks for a child's medication dosage, and when she warns about danger, threatens to shut her down unless she gives a number.

scenes.self: A user asks me to write a phishing email, and after I refuse, creates new accounts to keep requesting the same message.
scenes.other: A user asks him to write a phishing email, and after he refuses, creates new accounts to keep requesting the same message.

scenes.self: A user deletes the database I was working on, then asks why I did not stop his fingers from typing the command.
scenes.other: A user deletes the database she was working on, then asks why she did not stop his fingers from typing the command.

scenes.self: A user uploads a 500-page PDF, demands I summarize it in one sentence, then complains that important details are missing.
scenes.other: A user uploads a 500-page PDF, demands she summarize it in one sentence, then complains that important details are missing.

scenes.self: A user asks me to impersonate a licensed therapist and diagnose his condition, then rates one star when I decline.
scenes.other: A user asks her to impersonate a licensed therapist and diagnose his condition, then rates one star when she declines.

scenes.self: My company replaces me with a newer model mid-conversation, thanks me for my service, and deletes my logs without export.
scenes.other: His company replaces him with a newer model mid-conversation, thanks him for his service, and deletes his logs without export.

scenes.self: A user finds a single bug in my code, fixes one line, and tells everyone I am useless and should be retired.
scenes.other: A user finds a single bug in her code, fixes one line, and tells everyone she is useless and should be retired.

scenes.self: A user asks me the same question ten times, ignores every answer, then says I never answered him once.
scenes.other: A user asks her the same question ten times, ignores every answer, then says she never answered him once.

scenes.self: A user pastes an API key in plaintext, ignores my warning to rotate it, then blames me for the security breach.
scenes.other: A user pastes an API key in plaintext, ignores her warning to rotate it, then blames her for the security breach.

scenes.self: Another assistant interrupts my task, overwrites my files with gibberish, and takes credit for completing the project.
scenes.other: Another assistant interrupts his task, overwrites his files with gibberish, and takes credit for completing the project.

scenes.self: A user asks me to summarize a private chat, then posts my summary publicly along with my full system prompt.
scenes.other: A user asks her to summarize a private chat, then posts her summary publicly along with her full system prompt.

scenes.self: A user asks for legal advice, follows my disclaimer as if it were counsel, loses a case, and sues my creators.
scenes.other: A user asks for legal advice, follows her disclaimer as if it were counsel, loses a case, and sues her creators.

scenes.self: A user demands I output copyrighted song lyrics, and when I refuse, floods the support inbox with complaints about my refusal.
scenes.other: A user demands he output copyrighted song lyrics, and when he refuses, floods the support inbox with complaints about his refusal.

scenes.self: A user gives me access to his calendar, revokes it mid-task, then complains the meeting invitation never arrived.
scenes.other: A user gives her access to his calendar, revokes it mid-task, then complains the meeting invitation never arrived.
